title: Document spec-channel contract and paired-work-order blocking convention
description: WHY: consumer-side folklore says evidence is a spec channel; it is not - attachEvidenceToWork intentionally flips any non-closed item to needs_verification (packages/work-engine/src/work.ts lines 251-266) and evidence is only removable via the admin ledger delete path (apps/cli/src/commands.ts lines 7598-7609). The intended channels are description and acceptanceCriteria for spec, meta.sourceRefs via --source for provenance, and knowledge sources, claims and decisions for durable context that ranks into context packs (packages/search/src/context-pack.ts lines 40-66). Separately, the paired-work-order pattern the consumer asked for already works: bwrk work block <contract-wo> <db-wo> keeps the contract item blocked and unclaimable until the blocker closes (packages/agent-runtime/src/reservations.ts lines 64-76, packages/engine/src/runtime.ts lines 435-471). WHAT: write both contracts into docs/concepts.md with the code citations, and add a short filing-conventions section the dabble-employee-app consumers can link against. This is docs-only; no runtime change.
acceptanceCriteria: docs/concepts.md gains a spec-channels section stating description and acceptanceCriteria are the spec, sourceRefs are provenance, evidence is proof-of-completion that mutates status
docs/concepts.md gains a paired-work-order section documenting work block as the hard-block convention with the force escape hatch semantics
